basic_info.description: Built in 2014, this one bedroom condo is the epitome of luxury living in a premier location.  The property comes complete with a Wolf gas range and microwave, a Subzero refrigerator and wine cooler, custom cabinetry, quartz counters and a spa-inspired bathroom with designer fixtures.  There is even an elegant gas fireplace for evenings at home. This boutique 13 unit complex is just a short walk to Whole Foods, Mission Dolores Park, public transit and shopping.  Don't feel like walking?  Just hop on a Lyft bike, located right outside the entrance of the complex.  Don't feel like biking?  Drive your car right out of your secure gated parking space that comes with storage.  To top it all off, the HOA dues include water, trash, radiant heating and even internet access. This is a property not to be missed - welcome home to 200 Dolores!
